meta.planning_lock:
PLANNING LOCK (hard — plan OVER clusters, then write JSON):
- Fill ALL 3 days (nights≈2). No empty/partial days.
- Mandatory destinations (preferredRegions + mustVisit): Jerash, Dead Sea
- Destination→cluster map: Jerash→cluster 2 (Jerash Governorate · museums, photography); Dead Sea→cluster 0 (Madaba Governorate · photography, museums)
- Day→cluster route: D1:C2/Jerash → D2:C2/Jerash → D3:C0/Dead Sea
- mustVisit entity lock: Dead Sea→lead with Wadi Mujib Biosphere Reserve (Madaba Approach) (cluster 0)
- Each day uses entities primarily from its mapped cluster (meals/hotels from that cluster).
- Do not invent a parallel trip from random clusters; unused clusters are alternatives only.
- Lodging: rating=3 star, type=hotel. Reuse base hotel(s) across consecutive nights: Saint John Hotel, Saltus Hotel. One hotel per overnight base — do not rotate hotels daily in the same area.
- Selection bias: aiPriority=family; SME=(none). Prefer matching why_retrieved/facts among retrieved options.
- Budget target ≈ 1000.0 JOD when facts allow.
- Names/hours: EntityCards only. If not in evidence, skip — never invent.
- Prices: use the card value as-is; if missing, estimate from pricing_level and label it "~N JOD (estimated)".
- Events are reference only: never schedule them in the itinerary or budget.
